Roman_Balochi: Salam, tei hal chuk ant?

English_Translation: Hello, how are you?

Roman_Balochi: Man shar an, mehrbani.

English_Translation: I am fine, thank you.

Roman_Balochi: Pada diwan e wahd a milakat bit.
Urdu_Translation: پھر مجلس کے وقت ملاقات ہوگی۔
English_Translation: We will meet again later.

Roman_Balochi: Tei nam chi ant?
Urdu_Translation: آپ کا نام کیا ہے؟
English_Translation: What is your name?

Roman_Balochi: Mei nam Baloch ant.
Urdu_Translation: ار ہمارا نام بلوچ ہے۔
English_Translation: My name is Baloch.

Roman_Balochi: Shma koja rawan at?
Urdu_Translation: آپ کہاں جا رہے ہیں؟
English_Translation: Where are you going?

Roman_Balochi: Man baz woshhal an ki tra did.
Urdu_Translation: میں آپ کو دیکھ کر بہت خوش ہوا۔
English_Translation: I am very happy to see you.

Roman_Balochi: Roch bakhair, subhdam shar at.

Roman_Balochi: Shabih shar at, khuda hafiz.
Urdu_Translation: شب بخیر، خدا حافظ۔
English_Translation: Good night, goodbye.

Roman_Balochi: Man gis a rawan.

Roman_Balochi: Mei pit o mat baz mehrban ant.
